svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Noto Sans", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Journal architecture
svg.desc: Callers append through the journal writer, which validates against the event schema, chains the hash, records the run in the work-item index and writes a line under runs/. The reader replays the same files and returns both hashes.

g.text: CALLERS · ENGINE COMMANDS THAT WRITE EVENTS
